step.description: One tutorial step. TU-1 seeds only the round-1 steps; TU-6/TU-7 append round-2 steps without a schema change (the shape is fixed here, only content grows).

advance_on.description: Event id (opaque string, game-agnostic) that advances past this step, e.g. 'tile_clicked:tutorial_flute'.

allow.description: Input action ids allowed while this step is active (a whitelist; everything else is gated). Opaque strings, engine-agnostic.

flags.description: Free-form per-step data for the game-side director (D2). Deliberately open (additionalProperties: true) so later phases attach whatever they need with no schema bump.

highlight.description: Opaque highlight target ids this step lights up (a tile marker, a construction card, a UI button), e.g. 'tile:tutorial_flute', 'card:musician', 'button:confirm'.

id.description: Stable step id, unique within the script.

message.description: String id into the 'messages' object this step shows, or null for a step with no message box.

description: The guided tutorial script (D3, planning/TutorialPLAN.md): step list, both message texts, and the two behavioral toggles. Read by engine/tutorial.py's generic step-sequencer (TU-6); this schema only fixes the data SHAPE so TU-6/TU-7 can extend the step list without a schema change. Humans edit only through the editor's Tutorial section; agents via write_validated.

first_loss_costs_life.description: If true, the scripted first-round loss (no defences placed yet) costs a life like a normal loss; if false the first loss is free.

messages.description: The two message-box texts the tutorial shows, keyed by id (closed set - the step structure is fixed, only these texts are editor-editable).

economy_intro.description: First message box: explains economy buildings produce Love.

lives_intro.description: Second message box: explains the 3 lives / destroyed-economy / defence buildings after the scripted first loss.

skippable.description: If true, the first message box shows a Skip tutorial button.

title: tutorial
